description: This script manages DHCP switch operations, including scheduling and executing DHCP-related tasks via cron jobs, controlling WAN interface states, and toggling DHCP clients for IPv4 and IPv6. It also handles service management for dropbear and logs activities.

methods.name: calcExecTime
methods.description: Calculates a random execution time within a maintenance window for scheduling DHCP switch operations.

methods.name: ScheduleCron
methods.description: Schedules a cron job to run the dhcpswitch.sh script at a calculated time.

methods.name: RemoveCron
methods.description: Removes the scheduled cron job for dhcpswitch.sh.

methods.name: wait_till_state_wan_stopped
methods.description: Waits until the WAN interface status is 'stopped' or times out after 9 tries.

methods.name: wait_till_state_wan_started
methods.description: Waits until the WAN interface status is 'started' or times out after 1 try.
